messages:
ben_customer: Hey team — starting ~11:12UTC our production requests from eu-west are being routed to us-west. Seeing 500s and 900-1200ms p99. Request id rQ8-zz123, org=acme-inc. Also noticed doubled token billing for the same request. Can someone check routing/healthchecks?

alex_support: Thanks — can you paste the full request-id and a couple sample request headers (x-region, x-org, x-request-id)? I’ll escalate if needed.

ben_customer: Sure — sample header below:
```
x-request-id: rQ8-zz123
x-org: acme-inc
x-region: eu-west
Host: api.redwood.ai
```
Also attaching the call latency graph (high p95 since 11:12).

alex_support: Looping @jia_oncall and SRE. Initial hypothesis: routing fallback flipped regions for that org. Jia, can you pull the routing decision logs and healthcheck aggregator for eu-west around 11:10-11:20?

routing-bot: probe-aggregator: eu-west last_seen=2026-03-17T11:13:07Z, probes=3, status=OK (source-ips aggregated).

jia_oncall: I’m looking. Routing decisions show a cluster of failovers at 11:12:18 that preferred us-west for acme-inc for ~18m. The router decision was: eu-west marked UNAVAILABLE by region-liveness service -> fallback to us-west. Need heartbeat trace for the aggregator.

omar_sre: Quick dump from the heartbeat aggregator around that window. Paste of condensed log: 
```
[11:11:58] probe recv from 34.120.7.21 region=eu-west probe_id=probe-73
[11:12:02] probe recv from 34.120.7.54 region=eu-west probe_id=probe-74
[11:12:07] probe recv from 34.120.7.21 region=eu-west probe_id=probe-73
[11:12:12] probe recv from 52.14.9.3 region=eu-west probe_id=probe-75
[11:12:16] probe recv from 34.120.7.54 region=eu-west probe_id=probe-74
[11:12:28] aggregator: dedupe by source_ip -> seen_ips=[34.120.7.21,34.120.7.54,52.14.9.3]
[11:12:30] NAT rotation observed: source_ip 34.120.* changed mapping, short gap 8s
[11:12:31] aggregator computed last_heartbeat age=13s -> treated as STALE -> region UNAVAILABLE
```

jia_oncall: So the aggregator recently started deduping by source_ip only (PR #4291 last week) to reduce noise from multi-homed probes. NAT rotation plus dedupe created a false-negative gap (heartbeat age reported > TTL). Router then triggered fallback to us-west.

omar_sre: That matches the billing anomaly: requests were re-routed to us-west which uses a different inference pool that billed tokens against customer's dedicated capacity, and some in-flight retries led to doubled token accounting.

alex_support: Immediate mitigation options?

jia_oncall: Two quick mitigations: 1) Pin acme-inc to eu-west while we fix aggregator signature (manual override) 2) Increase probe-aggregator TTL to be tolerant of short NAT rotations (temporary config). I can apply the route pin now.

alex_support: Please do 1) now, and 2) as well if low risk. Include the commands so I can track.

jia_oncall: Running admin command now:
```
adminctl route-override --org acme-inc --preferred-region eu-west --reason "support emergency: avoid cross-region failover" --expire 3600
adminctl config-set probe.aggregator.ttl_seconds 14  --scope staging,prod
```

routing-bot: route-override applied for org=acme-inc -> eu-west (expires in 3600s).

ben_customer: Confirming — after the override latency dropped back to ~70ms and 200s returned. Thank you.

omar_sre: For the real fix we’ll update probe signature to include region tag + probe_id salt so dedupe won’t collapse multi-reporter probes from the same NAT pool. Also revert the recent dedupe-only-by-ip change and add a small jitter to probe sends. I’ve opened PR #4528 with tests.

jia_oncall: We’ll roll the TTL bump to prod config for 1h and monitor. Postmortem + follow-up actions:
- revert naive dedupe behavior (owner: omar_sre)
- add region tag to probe signature (owner: omar_sre)
- postmortem and billing remediation for acme-inc (owner: finance-eng)
- alert threshold: if fallback frequency > 2/min for a single org, page SRE instead of just ops channel (owner: oncall-tools)

alex_support: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-304 and billing ticket BILL-897. I’ll reach out to acme-inc with a short summary.

ben_customer: Appreciate the rapid response. One small ask: can you share the incident notes and the temporary override ID so we can reconcile billing?

ajia_oncall: override id: ov-1998765432-01. I’ll attach the incident notes when the postmortem is ready.

omar_sre: Root cause summary for postmortem: probe-aggregator dedupe-by-ip + NAT rotation created false-negative heartbeat -> region-liveness marked eu-west unavailable -> routing fallback to next cheapest region (us-west) -> cross-region routing caused increased latency and duplicate token accounting on customer workload. Fixes: PR #4528 + config TTL change + revert dedupe hotfix.

ben_customer: Thanks all, latency/back to normal and billing team acknowledged. :pray:
